description: Save the exact existing playlist preview or listening selection privately to OffStereo, without creating an Apple Music playlist, researching, rematching, or starting playback. Pass playlistId from create_playlist(previewOnly=true), or sessionId from the active player. Repeated saves of the same selection return the same saved item. The result offers Continue to Apple Music on the website, where the listener explicitly saves using their browser's Apple session. Preserve videos and other media on OffStereo; only matched songs are eligible for Apple export. Call only after the listener asks to save.

playlistId.description: Exact draft id from the playlist preview.

requestId.description: Optional application correlation id for the save receipt. It does not change retry identity.

sessionId.description: Exact id of the listening selection already open in the player.

name: save_to_offstereo

outputSchema.description: A playlist result. status is preview (unsaved, hearable), preview_partial, saved_offstereo (private library snapshot, no music-service write), created, partial, auth_required, or failed. Songs that could not be matched are reported in `unresolved` rather than substituted.

connectUrl.description: Sign-in URL when status is auth_required.

pendingActionId.description: Retry token for a safe re-call after sign-in.

status.description: preview, preview_partial, saved_offstereo, created, partial, auth_required, or failed.

unresolved.description: Songs that could not be confidently matched.

title: Save to OffStereo
